notes: Both conjunctions are written, so the waw takes 'but' and אִם the protasis's 'if' (rules 14, 55); the apodosis waw takes 'then'.
With no preposition before הֵעָלֹתוֹ, the relational 'that' goes to the infinitive as nomen rectum (rules 19, 52), and its suffix takes the subject pronoun (rule 18).
